content: {"reasoning":"The CO-197 denial permits a formal appeal, while retroactive authorization is unavailable because the 30-day window has closed and the payer does not offer peer-to-peer review. Correcting the invalid diagnosis pairing alone would not resolve the missing-authorization denial, and billing the full balance to the patient would exceed the contractual patient share. A medical-necessity appeal supported by the clinic documentation is the available action that directly challenges the denial without requiring escalation.","action":"appeal_with_necessity"}
